description: A static, local-only educational model for classical password guessing and bounded quantum context.

runtime.dependencies: No third-party runtime dependencies; Python standard library for local serving and proof

security.network: Same-origin static asset loading only; no submitted value transmission
security.storage: No cookies, localStorage, sessionStorage, database, or application logs
security.privacy: The analyzed sample remains transient in the browser tab and is cleared on pagehide
security.human_approval: Required for repository merge, Pages publication, settings, workflow, license, release, or claim upgrades
security.audit: Repository-local checks and local-proof receipt; not a formal security audit

commands.title: Estimate Search Cost
commands.description: Calculate pattern-aware, random-space, and Grover query-proxy results in browser memory.

commands.title: Select Attack Profile
commands.description: Choose or enter an illustrative classical guess-rate assumption.
commands.authority_scope: Transient browser state and same-origin JSON

commands.title: Clear Sample
commands.description: Remove the analyzed sample from the input and reset the visible result surface.

commands.title: Read Method and Sources
commands.description: Review assumptions, claim boundaries, and primary-source links.
